title: Expensive subscription
body: I really liked the app at first, nice, clean design, fairly customizable, but after a while it turns out I have to pay a monthly subscription which isn’t cheap for a student like me. Could be good for someone with more money but not me. For anyone poor, I recommend “Blossom”.
author: Šimon Kopecký

title: Love It!
body: Beautiful and simple layout. Many options for tracking your habit 👌 More icons and better colour picking would be great 😁
author: andreafikselova
